title: The Dog Night, 2015
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Sixteen years. The first Dog Night with the box instead of the dumpster. He goes to both.

panels.composition: The dumpster, night, the bulb. WOOD standing. BARNABY II on a leash, three legs, sniffing the chain-link with no idea.

image.prompt: a man standing behind a bowling alley at night before a rusted dumpster under a bulb, a wiry three-legged dog on a leash sniffing the chain-link fence with cheerful ignorance, clean ink, no words

panels.composition: Wood's hand on the fence where the rope was. The pup's nose at it too.

image.prompt: close-up of a man's hand on a chain-link fence and a young dog's nose pressed to the same spot, no words

panels.composition: The porch, later. The waxed produce box — ALICE'S WHOLESALE BAIT & SMOKED MEATS — kept, on the porch, the pup standing in it because he can.

image.prompt: a wiry three-legged dog standing proudly inside a battered waxed produce box on a porch at night, a man sitting on the step beside it, no words
image.notes: The box is kept on the porch. The Dog Night has two stops from here.

panels.composition: The sign, from the porch, far off across the town's roofs: SMALL WOOD LANES, three letters dark. Wood looking at it. The pup asleep in the box.

image.prompt: a man on a porch step at night looking across small-town rooftops toward a distant bowling-alley neon sign with three letters dark, a three-legged dog asleep in a produce box beside him, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: Two stops: the dumpster, the box. The box is kept.
